title: onoclea procera
intro: Onoclea procera, commonly known as the American maidenhair fern, is a type of vascular plant that belongs to the family Onocleaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Onoclea procera include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antispasmodic effects, making it a potential remedy for conditions like arthritis and digestive problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
